notes: Projected from the top 75 Athletic.net teams and the top 500 Athletic.net individuals per division/gender, each scored from their real season best 5K time -- not a real meet result.
Team-only scoring plus individual-qualifier displacement, per the real OHSAA rule that individual qualifiers only come from teams that did not qualify as a team.

Each region's `individuals` array holds supplemental entrants from the Athletic.net top 500 list who are NOT on one of that division's top-75 team rosters -- a runner whose school already has a top-75 team roster is never listed here, whether or not they're one of that team's own seven (see validateDivisionRoster()'s top-75-school check). Individuals are scored together with team runners in one shared race field (src/lib/mock_scoring.mjs's scoreTeams(teams, individuals)) so they create real displacement, but never contribute to or form a team score -- a team is never assembled from supplemental individuals, even five-plus from the same outside school.

Individual qualifiers are selected only after qualifying teams are removed from the field -- the eligible pool is every remaining team runner (from non-qualifying teams) plus every supplemental individual, ranked by real finish order together.
stateQualifiers and individualQualifiers are the real official counts from OHSAA's own 2026 Regional Sites, Schedule & Representation document -- not estimated.
Division I has no Northwest region -- all Division I teams are split only across Central, Northeast, and Southwest.

Each team's own region/athleticDistrict/ohsaaSchoolId/city fields are the source of truth for where it belongs; a team matched by name alone was never trusted -- OHSAA school ID + city + athletic district + gender decide the match, not name text.

A team or athlete that cannot be confidently matched to one real division/region is left out entirely rather than guessed into a bucket -- see src/lib/mock_scoring.mjs's validateDivisionRoster() for the automated half of this check (duplicate team/athlete across regions), which is a build-time hard failure, not a silent skip.

Resolved identity: Western Reserve, OHSAA school ID 1670, city Collins, is the Northwest district school -- confirmed 2026-09-21. Any 'Western Reserve' sourced from a Northeast context is a different real school and must be given its own distinct city and OHSAA school ID before being trusted; it is never the same record as ID 1670.
